earnings.title: Toast Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
highlights: Net income was $169 million and Adjusted EBITDA was $240 million in third quarter
Operating income was $165 million in Q3 2026 compared to $84 million in Q3 2025.
Net income was $169 million in Q3 2026 compared to $105 million in Q3 2025.
Diluted earnings per share was $0.29 in Q3 2026 compared to $0.16 in Q3 2025.
Net cash provided by operating activities was $198 million and Free Cash Flow was $181 million in Q3 2026.

quotes.text: We had another strong quarter: recurring gross profit streams 1 grew 27%, GAAP Operating Income margin 2 expanded to 26% and we added approximately 8,500 net locations.
Elena has been an exceptional partner to me and has played a critical role in shaping Toast’s success and financial strategy over the last five and a half years.

outlook: Non-GAAP subscription services and financial technology solutions gross profit in the range of $610 million to $620 million (22-24% growth compared to Q4 2025).
Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $200 million to $210 million.
Non-GAAP subscription services and financial technology solutions gross profit in the range of $2,375 million to $2,385 million (26% growth compared to 2025, up from 23-25% growth).
Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $840 million to $850 million (up from $805 million to $825 million).
